decision.basis: Presses d'Histoire Suisse (PHS) is a non-profit academic publishing house of the Unité d'histoire suisse of the University of Geneva (conditions de vente, phs.html): its shop sells its own newly printed Travaux d'Histoire Suisse volumes at 48 to 96 CHF (catalog.html, 2004-2009 titles, some sold out). The linked 'Livres d'occasion' page (antiquariat.html) is broken (a PHP fatal error for a missing config2.php is rendered instead of content), so no used or antiquarian book is inspectable. A new-book publisher without inspectable antiquarian stock is not an antique dealer. No auction or contemporary art seen.

Librairie Poids Plume (Jean-François Vuilleumier, Rue Etraz 7, 1003 Lausanne; Impressum-style footer, contact page poidsplume@poidsplume.ch, shop hours listed) is a real used and antiquarian bookshop (livres anciens et modernes). Its own 'Notre catalogue' page states the online catalogue is consulted and purchased only through third-party marketplaces and links to livre-rare-book.com and abebooks.fr merchant pages; the own domain holds no item, price or checkout. The site is also stale (copyright September 2012) and carries injected hidden spam links to unrelated shoe and handbag shops on every page, so the page integrity cannot be trusted. Marketplace-hosted-only storefronts are an owner decision; no data imported.

Antiquariat Kochkunst Bibliothek (Marcus van Sprang, Bolgenstrasse 7, CH-7270 Davos-Platz, +41 81 4130741; Jimdo site, imprint /about/) is a genuine mail-order antiquarian dealer for gastronomic literature (books from six centuries, AGB: 'Bücher, die teilweise mehrere hundert Jahre alt sind', Katalog I to V). However the site exposes no inspectable priced stock: the 'Kochbuch Empfehlung' pages are bibliographic notes on classic titles without prices or order function, the 'Antiquarische Kochbücher' page is an uncaptioned image gallery of about 1,700 photos loaded by script, and the catalogues are PDF files shown in a third-party powr.io embed titled 'Katalog Nummer 22 und aeltere' (old catalogues, no current price list). No cart, price or order function was seen on any page. No auction or contemporary art seen. Revisit only if a priced own catalogue appears.

300k (Wix site, 'Vintage Leuchten | 300k | Zürich') shows a real shop of vintage lamps with prices and a cart (shop page: Maison Rougier 1970 CHF 1'400, ETA Babylampe Kundalini 1997 CHF 750, Verner Panton, Poul Henningsen, Gae Aulenti items; several marked VERKAUFT), so the stock would qualify. But the site publishes no imprint, legal operator, address, e-mail or phone: the only contact is an on-page contact form, and /impressum, /agb and /kontakt return 404 (Wix home and product pages checked, rendered DOM included). With no named operator and no published e-mail or phone nothing can be onboarded. Recheck when an imprint or contact appears.

Moderniste / 'Espace moderniste 42', rue de Genève 42, 1004 Lausanne (opening Thursday 16-18h, Saturday 10-16h and by appointment, 'achat / vente mobilier design mid-century modern') lists priced design pieces on product pages (e.g. Wegner CH25 lounge chair CHF 3'000 with condition 'très bon état (neuf)', Artemide, Mazzega, Flos lamps) and an archive of sold pieces; stock is mid-century design but some items are described as new or reissued editions. The site has no mentions légales, no named operator or legal form and no phone number (only info@moderniste.ch; /mentions-legales, /contact and /politique-de-confidentialite return 404). The seller is not named on the site, so the UID register cannot be used to resolve it; the legal operator stays unconfirmed. Recheck when an imprint appears.

Patinamöbel (Shopify store, Bern) is a genuine vintage design dealer: products.json lists 250 products of which 217 carry 'Vintage' in the title (Danish and Swiss pieces such as Wegner, Kai Kristiansen, 1960s teak, Embru; 13 of the 20 currently available), with a minority of new ex-display brand items. Its own pages contradict each other on the seller and on the premises: /pages/impressum names bank account holder Liliane Baeriswyl-Grützner at Schauplatzgasse 9, 3011 Bern, while /policies/legal-notice names account holder Patinamöbel GmbH, the Dienstleistungen page announces a store at Seidenweg 26, 3012 Bern and the home page news is a 2024 notice about a future store. The UID register shows Patinamöbel GmbH (Seidenweg 26, 3012 Bern) in liquidation and a new sole proprietorship Patinamöbel Lilian Bäriswyl (Neubrückstrasse 70, 3012 Bern; register entry last changed 2026-11-25), so the legal operator and the sales premises are in transition. Conflicting operator identities and addresses: nothing imported. Recheck after the site is updated.

Stile Libero (Via San Gottardo 44, 6828 Balerna) is an interior-design consultancy and showroom for new furniture: official reseller of Molteni&C, Dada kitchens, new wardrobes, bathrooms, wallpaper, lighting and doors (Marchi and Prodotti pages). The 'vintage' page is a blog article about the vintage style; there is no vintage or antique stock and no catalogue or prices.

Vintage Store, Sägestrasse 27, 3550 Langnau im Emmental (WooCommerce, 352 products) is a general vintage and second-hand shop: public store API shows hardcover books from 1958 to 1995 at CHF 13 to 24, 1980s vinyl LPs, kitchen ceramics and household decor of the 1960s to 1980s, souvenirs, Dinky Toys, Ethno decor, plus about 40 to 60 original paintings of one contemporary artist (Gisela Artist Collection, 'Moderne Originalkunst'). Furniture is 3 items; antique and historic objects about 6, antiquarian books 4. No qualified antique or design stock dominates; general second-hand without qualified stock is out of scope, and the artist's own current paintings are contemporary art.

Antikhaus (Danielle Trachsel, Steinackerring 22, 5042 Hirschthal, info@antik-haus.ch, 062 721 48 81) is a small walk-in antiques shop (open since April 2017: farmhouse cupboards, ceramics, glassware). The WordPress/Divi site (no shop, no prices) consists of a start page, Über uns, Events and a photo gallery; there is no catalogue or priced item online. The start page announces an 'Ausverkauf' because the Antikhaus closes at the end of March (after nearly 8 years, i.e. a closing sale that is not dated to a year). No inspectable online stock and a closing business.

Walter Möbel & Wohnaccessoires (Zürich, Shopify) was reassessed from its public product feed: of 598 products only about 95 carry the vendor 'Walter Vintage', and of those about 40 are new bamboo rugs, 25 vintage rugs, 3 hemp rugs and 4 clips; genuine vintage furniture is a handful of pieces (4 tables, 2 sideboards, 1 armchair). The rest is new goods: Ferm Living, Normann Copenhagen, Frama, Montana, Schaffner, Urban Nature Culture, The Poster Club and the own-label Atelier Walter furniture. A predominantly new-furniture and home-accessory retailer; vintage is a minor side line. Consistent with the earlier CH deferral on the same scope (native focus on new and made-to-measure design).

Autorennbahn-Center Uzwil (Hans Tschudin, Bäckerweg 7, 9240 Uzwil; Wix) is a slot-car racing venue with championships, events and track rental since 2003. The 'An- und Verkauf' page is mainly a buying-in appeal and a note on spare parts for old tracks and new Carrera/BRM/TTS sets; the Märklin-Sprint Shop page is a parts-list lookup by e-mail request; the 'Renncenter Slotcars' page is a photo gallery. No priced, individually inspectable collectible stock and no catalogue; the hobby/new-toy trade is a side line of a leisure venue.

Photobook Genève (ex Altheia, Philippe Houdebert) is a photographer's studio selling silk scarves printed with his photographs and upcycled radios. The radios (Luxor console c.1929, Hofrela 541 of 1941) are taken apart, stripped of their original electronics and rebuilt with new internet-radio, Bluetooth and Airplay components for a 'transformation' commission with a numbered certificate, offered as 'contactez-moi pour une estimation' without prices. That is a creative upcycling service on old cabinets, not a dealer in genuine unaltered antiques, and the shop sells new photo-based scarves.

qualification.basis: Sportantiquariat Germond, Frankengasse 6, 8001 Zürich: antiquarian dealer for sports history ('An- & Verkauf von Sportmemorabilia', in business since March 2001, owner Gregory Germond, eidgenössisch diplomierter Buchhändler; press pages from NZZ, 24heures and WOZ). Own first-party catalogue of 9163 priced items (CHF with EUR) with per-item pages, bookno., year, condition and a cart: sports books, yearbooks, club chronicles, match programmes, magazines, posters, collector-card albums, photographs and memorabilia. Items seen with year and price: Nestlé sticker album 'Sports - une petite encyclopédie des sports' 1938 CHF 45; Kosmos Zigarettenbilder album 1951 CHF 48; official tennis programme Genève 18-19.9.1957 signed by Rosewall, Hoad, Segura and Kramer CHF 85; Almanacco illustrato del calcio 1963 CHF 60; a 1958 stadium ticket (Sportclub Kriens, 3 August 1958) in the new-arrivals teaser. The catalogue also holds recent programmes and magazines, but the antiquarian and historic share is substantial and genuine. Operator: the site names the shop and its Inhaber; the Swiss UID/commercial register lists sole proprietorship 'Sportantiquariat G. Germond' (CHE-226.990.228, CH02011052492) at exactly Frankengasse 6, 8001 Zürich. No auction, marketplace or contemporary-art stock seen. Mirror domains sport-buch.ch, librairiedusport.ch and sportbuecher.ch are recorded as aliases. Announced on the start page: the shop must vacate the Lokal at Frankengasse 6 at the latest by end of June 2027 and is looking for new premises; recheck the location after that date.

decision.basis: Re-reviewed fresh 2026-11-26 under policy B and the 2026-11-26 art rules. Handelshop Marzohl (about page: Handelshop Marzohl, 4612 Wangen bei Olten; contact page shows Sailern 12c, 3126 Gelterfingen) runs a Jimdo shop of signed paintings, prints and sculptures from artists' estates. The shop's own category text says 'Eine Riesen Sammlung von zeitgenössische Kunst'. Works dated on the catalogue pages are overwhelmingly post-1945 and recent: oil paintings signed 1953, 1957, 1968, 1977-1981, 1991-1994, Max Hari acrylic 2001, mixed-technique works 1963-2013, etchings 1957-1990, sculptures by Hans Etter (1939-2026) dated 2007 and 2009; only isolated items pre-1945 (for example Hans Obrecht 1936). Stock is therefore not predominantly pre-1945 and has far more than a trivial contemporary/living-artist share, so it is excluded under the contemporary / post-war art rule. AUCTION SIDE ACTIVITY (not decisive): the proprietor's 'über mich' page states 'auf ricardo.ch art-and-more ständig über 2000 laufende Auktionen' next to the own shop, and the category texts call the own shop only 'ein kleiner Teil' of the collection; not needed for this decision.

Re-reviewed fresh 2026-11-26. The whole site is a single static page 'Karg Numismatik Herisau' (Alpsteinstrasse 15b, Postfach 1212, 9102 Herisau; Samstag-Öffnungszeiten; Tel. 079 420 13 64; email auktionen@karg-auktionen.ch) listing only 'An und Verkauf von Banknoten, Münzen, Goldhandel, Militaria, Orden und Abzeichen, Briefmarken und Postkarten, Erbschaftsauflösungen, Schätzungen'. The identical page is served under karg-auktionen.ch and the contact email sits on an auction domain, but no page states whether or how auctions are run; there is no catalogue, no priced stock, no Impressum or named legal operator, and the apex host karg-numismatik.ch does not resolve in DNS (the www host works only over plain HTTP, its TLS certificate does not match). Auction share cannot be established from first-party pages and no inspectable own stock exists, so nothing can be onboarded or safely excluded: DEFERRED, never guessed.

Re-reviewed fresh 2026-11-26. KG Contemporary describes itself as 'an international art gallery and advisory platform' for 'contemporary Aboriginal art' (home: 'Aboriginal Art Geneva ... Miami - Geneva - French Riviera', 'Contemporary art selection', artists such as Emily Kam Kngwarray, Sally Gabori, Tommy Yannima Watson, works dated 1995-2009, fairs Volta Basel and Art Miami). Stock is contemporary Aboriginal art by living or recently active artists, so excluded under the contemporary-art rule regardless of the auction question (the about page also says the business organizes 'exhibitions, auction sales'). Operator split between KG Distribution LLC (Miami, FL, USA) and GFA SA (Rue de l'Ancien Port 6, 1201 Geneva) per the privacy policy; home country not decisive for this exclusion.

Stock is contemporary art, excluded under the contemporary-art rule; the auction question (a separate auction company rapp-auktionen.ch exists) is not decisive.

Re-reviewed fresh 2026-11-26. MINERVE, 'enseigne exploitée par MNRV Sàrl', Rue de Montchoisy 18, 1207 Genève, sales@minerve.ch, +41 77 212 15 27, visits by appointment. The /shop catalogue lists 12 antique/vintage silver objects (e.g. 18th-century Geneva silver ladle by Jean-Pierre Alquier, Jezler 800 service, candlesticks London 1970, Russian candlesticks); product pages say 'Enquire about this object', some prices appear as tiles on the home page. The site contradicts itself on the exact question: the home page and /info call MINERVE 'Auction House in Geneva' with 'Explore the auctions' and the sitemap holds past 'auction' pages (spring-silver-2025, winter-jewels-2025, fine-silver, watches-sale, collectibles-sale, an editorial 'Inside the hybrid auction model'), yet /auctions says 'Auctions in development' and /consignment says 'We act as specialist and intermediary and do not conduct our own auctions' (third-party auction houses, private sales, consignment). The 'previews' also show modern luxury watches/jewellery (Patek Philippe 2015, Cartier Love 2018) and the offers page mentions watches and Pokémon cards, so the actual catalogue mix is not established either. Cannot tell whether auctions are the main business or absent; no guess: DEFERRED. Re-check when the site states one consistent business model.

qualification.basis: Second own storefront of Guido Tön AG, Manessestrasse 170, CH-8045 Zürich: the footer address block and the payee line 'zugunsten von Guido Tön AG' appear on every page of poster-auctioneer.com, with Tel. +41 (0)44 777 35 35 and info@poster-auctioneer.com; the imprint of swissposterart.com (ADDED) names the same operator and contact, and the official UID register lookup recorded in that record lists Guido Tön AG, CHE-102.065.761, at the same address. The Party and its single location are reused (existingOperator). Own shop 'Poster Auctioneer, der Plakat Online Shop' with 4,960 individually priced original posters (complete listing: 248 pages of 20, read 2026-11-26), e.g. 'Anonym, Harder-Bahn, Interlaken', 1908, colour lithograph, condition B+/aJ, 97 x 69 cm, CHF 880; 'Brun Donald, Vacance in Svizzera', 1945, CHF 1,100; 'Abegg H., See-Sängerfest Küsnacht bei Zürich', 1911, CHF 450; 'Adelman, BEA - Fly freight', 1955, CHF 600. The home page states 'Reproduktionen, nein danke. Bei uns werden ausnahmslos Originalplakate auktioniert und verkauft.' A sample of 220 posters (11 listing pages spread over the alphabetical listing) is dated 13% before 1940, 43% 1940-1959, 14% in the 1960s and 30% from 1970 on (about 7% 1970s, 10% 1980s, 12% 1990 on), so historic and vintage posters (70% before 1970) dominate and the post-1970 minority is commercial and cultural poster work, not contemporary art; no new goods, reproductions or prints found. Spot checks of five titles (Harder-Bahn, Radion, Jelmoli, Vacance, Brünig) against the public store API of swissposterart.com found no identical item, so this catalogue is separate from that source. AUCTION SIDE ACTIVITY: the operator is a poster auctioneer ('Auktionshaus seit 1989'; numbered online auctions 1/1989 to 1/2022 are listed in the archive) and this site carries the auction brand, an archive of closed auctions and a realised-prices database, but the auction page states 'Unsere letzte Online-Auktion ist bereits Geschichte. Gut 100 Plakate kamen unter den Hammer' (result list of 3 March 2022; the next date is only announced as 'in Kürze'; no current auction, lot or bid is listed), the shop page says posters can also be ordered 'ausserhalb der Auktion', and the auction page says 'Unser Webshop mit attraktiven Plakatangeboten ist jahrein, jahraus, und rund um die Uhr offen'. The always-open own fixed-price shop (4,960 posters) therefore outweighs auctions of about 100 lots that last ran in 2022, so auctions are a past or side activity of a dealer that sells own stock at fixed prices (same judgement as for swissposterart.com). Open owner judgement: 30% of the sample dates from 1970 on, below the owner's 'mainly post-1970' line (poster-gallery.com 70% and awarded-poster.com 57% were excluded). Delivery: availability is confirmed by e-mail within 48 hours and the order is dispatched by post after payment, 3 to 14 days depending on destination (shop page).

omissions: No shipping terms asserted: the site only states dispatch by post after payment and 3 to 14 days depending on destination; it publishes no destinations, rates or collection terms, and the delivery terms of swissposterart.com's AGB (CHF 40/70/90) are not carried over to this separate shop.

No logo asserted: the only header image (logo.jpg, 291 x 107 px JPEG) is a small grey banner reading 'Plakate Affiches Posters' with the person's name 'Guido Tön', low resolution and not a brand logo of the shop.
No platform asserted: the shop is a custom application (web design credit 'Grairitweb.com') without a concrete commerce-platform fingerprint; technology hints are empty.

Münzstätte Münzsatz 2026, Cook Islands/Perth Mint issues at CHF 115-575), official new Swiss commemorative coins, coloured investment coins, silver bars, a silver-ounce subscription, pins, fashion jewellery, zodiac figures and Roger Federer / Queen Elizabeth II merchandise. Dedicated new-goods shop parts exceed the 5% limit.

Mirabi Orientteppiche Thun (Untere Hauptgasse 16, Thun): carpet shop that selects newly knotted hand-made carpets directly at the production sites ('nachhaltige Produktion, Farbechtheit'), plus rug underlays, repair and cleaning. The website is photo-only: category pages (Gabbeh, Kelim, Traditionell) show a few carpet names without prices or descriptions and refer to the shop for the rest ('Für das weitere Angebot begrüssen wir Sie gerne in unserem Geschäft'); 'Isfahan auf Seide antik' is a single name with no detail. No inspectable priced antique stock; retail of new carpets plus services.

Tschiep-Tschiep, Räffelstrasse 11, Zürich: online comic shop that sells mostly new publisher stock (own text: 'meistens Neuware mit kleinen Mängeln'), listed by publisher with ISBN and price (e.g. DC Deutschland, CrossCult, Finix Comics), plus a small second-hand box on site. New-goods retail of current comics and graphic novels, no antique or vintage collectible stock.

Uhren-Shop.ch: online retailer of new watches and clocks (menu: Batterie Quartz, Solaruhren, Funkuhren, Kinderuhren, Smart/Bluetooth, Taucheruhren, Wecker, Kuckucksuhren, straps and watch winders; '5% auf ersten Einkauf mit Code', 'Kostenlose Priority Lieferung'). The pocket-watch brand page lists new quartz and mechanical pocket watches. New-goods retail, no vintage or antique stock.

Watch-Lounge (WooCommerce shop): the 'Vintage und Pre-Owned' category holds five items (e.g. ATOWAK Cobra, Fortis Flipper NOS, CWC military chronograph, Omega Ploprof Mark III at CHF 9,590), but the shop's main product tree consists of new watch brand lines (Steinhart, Zeno-Watch Basel, Kufa, Palladium, Suprarub, Eqvis, Strom Timepieces) plus straps, buckles, tools and watch winders. New goods far exceed the 5% mix limit and form dedicated shop sections.

Brockenshop.ch (owner Giordano Drieman, Langnau im Emmental, UID CHE-475.366.734): self-styled 'online Brockenstube' with general departments (car audio, tools, clothing, shoes, electronics and cables, DVDs, guitars, kitchenware, plants, toys, drones). The 'Antiquitäten' category returns 'Es wurden keine Produkte gefunden'. General second-hand and mixed goods without qualified antique or vintage stock.

Antiquariat Im Seefeld, Seefeldstrasse 189, Zürich: one-page site with address, hours, a special offer of about 600 erotic videos (1990-2000) and subject links. Stock covers general used books (hardcover, paperbacks), records, CDs and DVDs; 'Bibliophile Ausgaben' and 'Raritäten' are menu words without items. The site holds no own catalogue or prices; the category links point to ZVAB seller searches, and the one opened (Kunst/Grafik) returned 'keine exakten Suchtreffer'. No inspectable priced stock and the stock is general second-hand media.

Buchhandlung Wortreich, Glarus: new-book retailer (online shop on buchkatalog.ch, readings, events, handicraft section). The 'Antiquariat' page says tens of thousands of old books exist, only some of them recorded and visible via ZVAB; the site has no own antiquarian catalogue. Predominantly new books and events; no inspectable own antique stock.

Bruno Röllin AG, Regensdorf: waste disposal, recycling, clearance and transport company. The 'RetroMarkt' online shop sells reusable second-hand goods from clearances (office furniture, cabinets, workbenches, workshop equipment) as a supplementary service. General used goods, no qualified antique or vintage stock.

qualification.basis: Wilfried Heiber GmbH (UID CHE-114.061.882; the UID register lists an active GmbH at Auf dem Wolf 30, 4052 Basel, matching the shop AGB and the main-site imprint; the shop imprint prints the firm name without 'GmbH') runs the Brocki auf dem Wolf Basel and its curated online shop shop.brockiwolf.ch (WooCommerce, about 600 items at fixed CHF prices with add-to-cart; sold items stay listed at CHF 0.00). Sampled 143 unique item titles over 12 listing pages: the large majority are dated vintage or antique objects, e.g. Bakelite clamp lamp 1930, Art Deco glass figure, Space Age coat hangers Finland 1969, Eileen Gray E 1027 side table CHF 420, Embru and Kienzle furniture 1950s, Walter Bosse brass figures, Nagel candle holders, Wagenfeld Kubus service 1938, Swiss army militaria (Offiziersdolch M43 CHF 140, Ordonnanzsäbel Modell 1883 CHF 240, Sägebajonett Modell 1914, Käppi 1957). Categories: Design Klassiker 42, Antiquitäten-Kunst 12, Sammlungen-Kuriositäten 17, Militaria 62, Technik 4 vintage telephones, Fashion 3. BORDERLINE share: the operator is a general Brockenstube (2,500 m2 clearance shop) and only the online shop is curated vintage; a small share (about 5% of the sample) is used modern fashion or modern design (Gucci, Prada, Ray-Ban, Kevlar helmet). No new-goods section, no reproductions, no contemporary art seen. Auction check: no own auctions; the main-site services page links a third-party Ricardo listing channel (format not inspected), the own shop is fixed-price only. Delivery within Switzerland only (AGB: 'beliefert ausschliesslich die Schweiz'; FAQ: no postal shipments outside Switzerland), pickup at the shop.

qualification.basis: Uhrmacheratelier Albert und Brigitte Kägi, Müsegg 1, Bülach (contact page, page titles, logo and footer) sells antique clocks and watches from its own stock through priced catalogue pages: gold Lépine pocket watch with quarter repeater by Gaberel & Dufour, Geneva c.1830 CHF 3,900; Louis XVI cylinder watch by Berthoud in a gold case CHF 3,400; silver pocket watch for the Chinese market c.1840 CHF 1,850; Louis XIV pendule from the early 18th century CHF 8,400; Zürcher Kommodenuhr by Bachoffen c.1720/40 CHF 8,900; Entlebucher Bodenstanduhr CHF 6,800; 18th-century pocket-watch stand CHF 1,500; music box CHF 1,850; wall clocks include a Bernese Ratsherrenuhr c.1730/40 and a late-Gothic iron clock c.1600. The proprietors have run the watchmaker's workshop since 1980 and give a 2-year warranty on sold clocks. No auctions, no new goods, no contemporary art. BORDERLINE ACTIVITY: the owners are past retirement age and state that they are reducing their large stock step by step ('solange es die Website noch gibt', images 'nicht unbedingt aktuell'), no longer accept repair orders, and sell all clocks only in the shop in Bülach by appointment; no closing date or closure is announced. No imprint page exists: the operator is the business as named on the contact page with its address and phone, no legal form is asserted, and UID register name searches ('Uhrmacheratelier', 'Kägi Uhren') returned no entry.
